title: AirMonitor Compare Prints
description: Side-by-side comparison of two to four prints (Print A/B by default; fill in C/D to add more) -- summary stats plus VOC, PM2.5, and temperature curves aligned on elapsed time since each print's own start, with an adjustable pre/post time window, so a filtered run can be compared against an unfiltered one, one filter medium against another, or different fan speeds/enclosure states, per the comparative-experiment goal in docs/architecture.md.

list.name: print_a
list.label: Print A
list.query: WITH candidates AS (SELECT printf('%s — %s — %s (#%d)', substr(started_at, 1, 16), COALESCE(NULLIF(subtask_name, ''), 'Unnamed print'), COALESCE(NULLIF(filament_type, ''), 'unknown filament'), id) AS __text, CAST(id AS TEXT) AS __value, started_at FROM prints WHERE started_gcode_state = 'RUNNING' OR last_gcode_state = 'RUNNING' OR ended_gcode_state IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 12) SELECT '— None —' AS __text, '' AS __value, 0 AS sort_order, '' AS started_at UNION ALL SELECT __text, __value, 1 AS sort_order, started_at FROM candidates ORDER BY sort_order, started_at DESC;

julianday(p.started_at)) * 1440, 1) AS time_bucket, s.temperature_c AS value FROM sgx_voc_samples s JOIN prints p ON p.id = s.print_id WHERE s.print_id = CAST('$print_b' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-' || $window_minutes || ' minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+' || $window_minutes || ' minutes') UNION ALL SELECT 'c' AS slot, ROUND((julianday(s.sampled_at) - julianday(p.started_at)) * 1440, 1) AS time_bucket, s.temperature_c AS value FROM sgx_voc_samples s JOIN prints p ON p.id = s.print_id WHERE s.print_id = CAST('$print_c' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-' || $window_minutes || ' minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+' || $window_minutes || ' minutes') UNION ALL SELECT 'd' AS slot, ROUND((julianday(s.sampled_at) - julianday(p.started_at)) * 1440, 1) AS time_bucket, s.temperature_c AS value FROM sgx_voc_samples s JOIN prints p ON p.id = s.print_id WHERE s.print_id = CAST('$print_d' AS INTEGER) AND datetime(s.sampled_at) BETWEEN datetime(p.started_at, '-' || $window_minutes || ' minutes') AND datetime(COALESCE(p.ended_at, p.last_seen_at), '+' || $window_minutes || ' minutes')) combined GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;
